defs.def: to make a hole in the ground or to move soil from one place to another using your hands, a tool or a machine 掘（地）；凿（洞）；挖（土）

ex.s: What do we know about those who first dug for gold in Dawson?
ex.t: 关于那些最早在道森挖金子的人，我们知道什么？

ex.s: To construct a working still, use a sharp stick or rock to dig a hole four feet across and three feet deep.
ex.t: 要制作一个可用的蒸馏器，用尖棍或石头挖一个四英尺宽、三英尺深的洞。

ex.s: Dig a hole of a certain size.
This affects the crops grown on the land and, in turn, the animals and humans who digest them.
ex.t: 这影响了土地上种植的作物，进而影响了消化这些作物的人和动物。

ex.s: Merit and his team at Environmental Design installed underneath the root ball a platform of seven-inch-diameter,44-foot-long steelbars and, just below the rods, a first set of uninflated airbags ( shown in gray).The team also dug a shallow ramp.
ex.t: Merit 及其环境设计团队在根球下方安装了一个平台……团队还挖了一条浅坡道。

ex.s: Of the first 20,000 people who dug for gold, 4,000 got rich.
ex.t: 在前20,000名挖金子的人中，有4,000人发了财。

defs.def: to remove sth from the ground with a tool 掘得；（采）掘出
to search in sth in order to find an object in sth 寻找，搜寻（物品）

ex.s: Mecca dug deep into his backpack, and____25____a Snickers.
ex.t: Mecca 在背包深处翻找，____25____了一根士力架。

defs.def: to approve of or like sth very much 赞成；看中；喜欢
to search thoroughly for information 探究；搜集；细查
to try hard to provide the money, equipment, etc. that is needed 尽力提供（所需金钱、设备等）
开始吃吧
to wait, or deal with a difficult situation, with great patience 耐心等待；忍耐；忍受
to mix soil with another substance by digging the two substances together （把 … ）掺进土中，混入土壤
to push sth into sth else （把 … ）戳进，插入
to start to eat food with enthusiasm 开始津津有味地吃；开始贪婪地吃

ex.s: Eating slowly also allows your body to digest your food better, and will allow you to enjoy your food more.
ex.t: 慢慢吃饭也能让你的身体更好地消化食物，并使你更享受食物。

defs.def: to push or rub against your body in a painful or uncomfortable way 挤痛，磨痛，碰痛（身体部位）
to find out information by searching or asking questions 探究；探寻；探询
to mix soil with another substance by digging the two substances together （把 … ）掺进土中，混入土壤
to push or press sth into sth else （把 … ）戳进，插入，压入
to remove sb/sth from somewhere by digging the ground around them or it 挖掘出

ex.s: Soon after the quakes, the army sent 150,000 soldiers to Tangshan to dig out those who were trapped and to bury the dead.
ex.t: 地震后不久，军队派出15万名士兵前往唐山，挖掘被困人员并掩埋死者。

ex.s: Come and help me dig her out!” shouted the soldier.
ex.t: '过来帮我把她挖出来！'那个士兵喊道。

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.
ex.t: 在重型起吊开始前，团队评估了根系，并在树干周围挖出一个五英尺深、直径40英尺的圆柱体，以保护所有重要根系。

defs.def: to find sth that has been hidden or forgotten for a long time 找出，发掘，发现（藏着的或被遗忘的东西）

ex.s: As you slowly explore your surroundings, you will start to dig up clues that give you a greater understanding of the poem.
ex.t: 当你慢慢探索周围环境时，你将开始挖掘出线索，让你对这首诗有更深的理解。

defs.def: to break the ground into small pieces before planting seeds, building sth, etc. （在播种或建筑前）掘地，平整土地

ex.s: This included digging up the road, ____63___ (lay) the track and then building a strong roof over___64___ top.
ex.t: 这包括挖开路面、____63____（铺设）轨道，然后在____64____顶部建造坚固的顶棚。

defs.def: to remove sth from the ground by digging 掘起；挖掘出
to discover information about sb/sth 发现；搜集；查明
a small push with your finger or elbow （用手指或肘部）轻碰，轻戳，轻推
a remark that is intended to annoy or upset sb 挖苦；嘲讽
an occasion when an organized group of people dig in the ground to discover old buildings or objects, in order to find out more about their history 考古发掘
